title: The Daily Howl: 3-0, and Off to Cleveland Tonight
text:
The Daily Howl: 3-0, and Off to Cleveland Tonight — TWolves Blog 
 Skip to content TWOLVES BLOG Timberwolves Game Coverage Daily Howl Lynx Injury Report Schedules Wolvespedia The Daily Howl The Daily Howl: 3-0, and Off to Cleveland Tonight
 The Wolves routed a Kawhi-less Toronto 117-94 to start 3-0, and now head to Cleveland on a back-to-back tonight, plus the Lynx weigh an offseason size problem.
 TWolves Blog Staff October 26, 2026 · 2 min read Three games, three blowouts — by 25, 22 and 23 — and the Wolves are the NBA’s last unbeaten. Now comes the real test: a back-to-back in Cleveland tonight.
 The Links
 TSN: Raptors Blown Out for First Loss as Kawhi Sits — Ant’s 26 and LaMelo’s 4-of-5 from deep bury a Leonard-less Toronto 117-94 in the home opener.
 Star Tribune: Wolves Deliver Third Straight Blowout — local depth on a 3-0 start running a net rating north of +20.
 TWolves Blog: Wolves 117, Raptors 94 — 3-0, and Only One Worry — our recap on the one thing still nagging an otherwise perfect week.
 ESPN: Timberwolves 117-94 Raptors — Recap & Box — the full line: 56% from the floor, 48% from three, a 49-34 rebound edge.
 TheSpread: Wolves at Cavaliers Preview — Minnesota on the second night of a back-to-back against a rested Cleveland front line.
 TWolves Blog: The 42% Mirage — Can the Wolves Survive Real Size? — timely ahead of a Mobley-and-Allen Cavs test tonight.
 MinnPost: The Undersized Lynx Face a Hard Offseason — finding size and depth won’t be easy with Collier’s free agency looming.
 Listen & Watch
 Locked On Wolves (Ben Beecken) — daily pod breaking down a 3-0 start and the Cleveland back-to-back.
 The Dane Moore NBA Podcast — reported takes on whether the blowout math holds up against the East’s best.
